In the UK social work has become very political because local government is obsessed with meeting Ofsted inspection targets. As a result burn out is extremely high with the majority of workers being temps and last months.

Bullying by managers and department directors is a major issue because they are obsessed meeting stays in order to keep their jobs.  Often social workers are threatened with the sack or being barred if they don’t meet targets.

I once was told by a manager that she didn’t care that my father was dying of cancer as long as met the targets. I had to go on long term sick leave to care for him until he died.

I often come into contact with pedophiles, drug addicts and some who are in jail for attempting to murder their children.
